controls: perfect forecast improves on fixed mean
equal baseline and exact zero boundary
population: Every saved neutral sampled action on the seven dates after the two seed dates; all short-target statuses retained. Forecast errors use explicitly eligible short targets only.
target: The original generation marked fill value during the 250ms after actual cancellation effect, in cents. Same short target as the fixed market-only recovery model. Not full Q10.
baseline: One constant equal to the eligible short-target mean on both seed days only; never refit the mean on calibration or test outcomes.
metrics: Daily and pooled RMSE, MAE, bias, squared-error improvement versus the seed mean; fixed score bins and the nonnegative-estimate region. The one preceding calibration date is descriptive only. The six-date uncertainty resamples UTC days1000times, seed20261113, for the mean of daily MSE improvements (equal day weights). No action-selection null or trading-performance inference is made by this forecast audit.
bins_convention: Left closed, right open; null endpoints mean unbounded.
verification: Reconstruct every action market feature from the original corrected causal grid; verify source/data/model identities and preserve all actions in a saved prediction artifact.
limits: Consumed history; neutral resting-order proxy, not identified fresh-entry value or calibration on recovery-wait states. No tuning, refitting, policy selection, or change to the frozen strategy success gates from this diagnostic.
